      "quote": "nit: I'd still prefer the easier C++11 std::vector here (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36692#issuecomment-6501722895) but I'll leave it to other reviewers to decide.",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Copy instead of moving elements for views so std::span does not move elements out",
      "quote": "I think std::span{inputs} would still move the elements out of inputs. Copying for views avoids that. What do you think?",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed a fix moving only when range yields rvalues",

      "status_by_id": "rc:4421462027",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed it. Instead of moving when `R` is an rvalue, we want to move when R *yields* rvalues."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4416488577",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Should the CTransaction constructor taking inputs and outputs be marked explicit?",

      "status_by_id": "rc:4416898958",
